连词 and / but / or / so: 四个基础连词连接对等成分:and 表并列,but 表转折,or 表选择,so 表因果。
and 并列:I like tea and coffee.|but 转折:cheap but good|or 选择:tea or coffee?|so 结果(前面是原因):It rained, so we stayed home.|注意 so 与 because 不同句:Because it rained, we stayed home.|连词连接的成分形式须一致
I have a brother and a sister.
column3: 我有一个哥哥和一个姐姐。

连词 and / but / or / so: The bag is small but heavy.
Hurry up, or we'll miss the train.
column3: 快点,不然我们就赶不上火车了。

# title: I like music ___ I don't like sports.
It was late, ___ we took a taxi home.
She can sing ___ dance very well.
column4: 两项都能,表并列用 and。

# title: Study hard, ___ you will fail the test.
column4: 否则的否定结果用 or。

# title: The phone is cheap, ___ it works well.
column4: 便宜却好用,转折用 but。
